sources.finding: Qwen3.5-4B vision tower remains 24 layers, hidden size 1024, patch 16, spatial merge 2, output 2560.
get_image_features returns vision pooler_output before language-model execution; unmerged last_hidden_state is also physically present in the vision output.
libmtmd batch owns an aggregated output embedding buffer for multimodal chunks.
llama-server reads mtmd_batch_get_output_embd and decodes the image chunk using that embedding buffer, preserving the physical feature-tap opportunity.

State Transition Pretraining jointly predicts actions from state changes and next states from current state+action; reported gains indicate action-grounded visual transition structure is a meaningful representation axis.
Training-free state-machine GUI memory can reduce repeated model calls; execution failures trigger visual re-grounding and memory repair.
Structured executable GUI memory as a knowledge graph can improve long-horizon planning and reduce token cost, motivating a graph baseline but not direct authority transfer.
Separating persistent task state from transient observations and using pre/post-action transition-aware verification improves long-horizon GUI agents without backbone modification.
Naive full-image visual memory can worsen hidden-operation blindness/grounding; action-grounded local visual memory outperformed full-image memory in reported OSWorld experiments.
Adaptive quadtree spatial compression can reduce GUI visual tokens with small measured performance loss; temporal consistency matters.
GUI-specific spatial/temporal redundancy can be exploited in KV-cache compression, supporting a later cache-reuse branch with strict invalidation.

Strong Qwen multimodal embedding behavior is obtained through explicit multi-stage contrastive/ranking training, countering any assumption that raw generative vision features are automatically calibrated open-set embeddings.
VLMs become strong embedding models through contrastive adaptation; raw feature suitability for MVC remains an empirical question.

counterevidence_summary: Transition memory can amplify visual aliasing, stale state and confirmation bias; full-image memory may worsen action-level failures; raw VLM features are not automatically calibrated retrieval embeddings; therefore VSTG must be task-bound, provenance-bound, abstaining, and verified post-action.
